source_text.body:
Plan meals and order the groceries
A parent used Dot to create meals, build a grocery list, and fill the cart and order through a store app.
·
Oct 16, 2026
Done with
DO
Dots
What they did
On the mobile app, the poster used the new Dot assistant on a Pro account to create meals for their kids, turn that into a grocery list, and then place the order through the store app. In replies, they say the key difference was that Dot did the shopping itself by filling the cart, ordering, and paying, rather than just producing a list.
How it went
It worked well enough that they made one of the suggested dinners the next night and called the experience fantastic. The thread gives no hard numbers, and the only limitation mentioned is that the poster had failed to get this working with regular Pro before Dot.
Worth knowing
Their setup was mobile-only, and they say this full cart-and-checkout flow only worked for them with Dot on a Pro account.
Try it yourself
with
Dots
Copy prompt
Plan [number] dinners for my [household description] for the week of [date], keeping to [dietary needs, budget, and foods we dislike]. Build one combined grocery list, then open my [store name] app and fill the cart with those items, picking [brand or price preferences]. Stop before checkout and show me the cart, substitutions, and total so I can approve the order.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/ChatGPT/comments/1x73g3n/thrilled_utilized_new_dot_assistant_on_pro
